Yep, surely we could sneak a 2nd on what was more or less our home patch ... but the race was to be full of surprises and as the team declaration was handed in we were missing two of our key men in Dave Pamah and Dave Beaver although boosted by the very welcome return to the fold of a gaunt and fit looking Ray Foley.
